page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ic5.4xlarge is a compute-focused instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz. It features 16 vCPUs across 8 physical cores with 2 threads per core, running on a KVM hypervisor. The instance is allocated 16.0 GB of RAM, yielding 1.0 GB per vCPU core. It has 35 MB of L3 cache and supports AVX-512 vector instructions. The server includes no local disk storage and relies on network-attached storage, supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps. No dedicated hardware GPUs are attached.

Benchmark evaluations indicate average multi-core compute capability alongside lower single-core performance. A single-core Geekbench score of 991.0 and stress-ng single-core score of 1105.99 reflect weak single-threaded execution, as demonstrated by poor single-threaded gzip compression throughput. However, multi-core benchmarks such as Passmark CPU score (12997.09) and Geekbench multi-core (6191.0) achieve average standard scores. System memory tests show lower relative efficiency, evidenced by a weak Passmark memory score of 1695.78.

Given its 1:1 vCPU-to-RAM ratio in gigabytes, the server prioritizes parallel compute core density over large memory capacity. This configuration provides high resource efficiency for parallelized processing workloads that do not require extensive RAM or persistent local disk space. Supported workloads include multi-threaded software compilation, static web serving, parallelized batch processing, and Redis caching services.
description: The Alibaba Cloud ecs.ic5.4xlarge is a compute-oriented cloud server provisioned with 16 vCPUs across 8 physical cores and 16.0 GB of RAM, powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor at 2.5 GHz. Built on a KVM hypervisor, the instance provides 5 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth and contains no local disk storage or dedicated GPUs. Performance benchmarks show average multi-core CPU capacity, highlighted by a Passmark CPU score of 12997.09 and a multi-core Geekbench score of 6191.0. Single-core throughput and memory subsystem metrics rank in lower percentiles, with a single-core Geekbench rating of 991.0. Featuring a 1:1 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is suited for parallelized execution tasks with moderate memory requirements, including multi-threaded software compilation, static web serving, and containerized batch workloads.
